name: web-outdoor-fashion-bento-hero-with-shop-now-circle
title: Outdoor clothing homepage as a bento of grey headline card and photo tiles
whatItIs: A white rounded frame with a pill nav and search. Inside, a warm grey card with a heavy caps headline 'FOR EVERYONE BUT NOTANYONE' and an arrow, two small photo tiles of hats with hashtags, and a tall photo of a man in an olive bucket hat with a translucent SHOP NOW circle and two pill buttons.
whatItMeans: Confident and editorial; a bento of unequal tiles gives a fashion feel.
techniques: Split the hero into one text card and several photo tiles.
Set a heavy grotesque headline with an inline arrow.
Overlay a translucent circular button on the photo.
Tint tiles to match the clothing (olive, green, grey).

vocabulary.definition: A hero made of tiles of different sizes.
A label with a hashtag over a photo.
A translucent circle acting as a button.
A navigation bar in a rounded capsule.
